about_the_game:
Embark on a journey through the arcane depths of Taromancy, a strategic deck-building roguelike that intertwines the mystic power of Tarot with endless gameplay possibilities. Each playthrough, uncover and harness the forces of unique tarot-inspired cards, face ominous fates, and weave your own destiny.

In Taromancy, the path you tread is never the same twice. Venture through randomized routes filled with cryptic encounters, arcane challenges, and mystical boons, each one casting an impact on your journey’s outcome. Select cards inspired by the Tarot’s Major and Minor Arcana, forging a deck that aligns with your personal strategy, from harnessing potent energies of The Magician to unleashing the destructive wrath of The Tower.

Key Features:

  • Dynamic Deck-Building with Tarot Mechanics: Craft your deck from a rich array of Tarot-themed cards, each representing unique abilities and strategies. Combine cards in infinite ways to adapt to each new threat and find synergy within the mysteries of the Tarot.

  • Ever-Changing Paths: No two journeys are alike. Your path shifts with each playthrough, providing fresh and unpredictable challenges as you ascend through realms shaped by Tarot archetypes and encounters.

  • Arcane Boons and Enhancements: Discover mystical boons that offer powerful changes to the game mechanics and redirect the course of your journey. Every boon is steeped in Tarot lore, from sacred amulets to enchanted charms that infuse your deck with extra power.

  • Unlock New Characters with Unique Tarot Alignments: Discover and unlock a diverse cast of characters, each attuned to specific Tarot archetypes and boasting unique abilities. Master their individual strengths and styles as you adapt to ever-shifting fates and challenges.

  • Infinite Replayability: With countless card combinations, an array of unique Tarot-inspired enemies, and evolving paths, Taromancy promises a fresh experience every time. How you play, and how you survive, depends on how you interpret the cards.

Prepare to delve into a mystical world where each choice shapes your destiny. Will you master the Tarot's power and ascend, or will your journey end in the shadows?

Taromancy Plans to have: 

Dozens of characters that each have their own unique playstyle

350+ fully implemented cards.

100+ different boons.

100+ unique combat encounters.

100+ mysterious events that can help or harm you.

The cards await. Enter the realm of Taromancy.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2500K / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 770 / AMD Radeon R9 270X (or equivalent with DirectX 11 support)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card

short_description: Taromancy is a roguelike deck builder blending Tarot-inspired themes with strategic card battles. Craft powerful decks, master the arcana, and navigate shifting realms filled with unpredictable foes. Embrace fate, discover unique combos, and face new challenges with every run.
